---
name: safety-oracle
description: Portable compiler safety checks.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [requester, assistant]
---
contract @infinity => expired
type question
 text: text(100, regex: ~r/(?=a)a/)
state new
 requester -> assistant: question() => complete
end complete

error.detail: Pattern is outside the safe pattern subset
